author: cayopku
abstract: NeuroForge Nuxt is a specialized engineering system for building premium SaaS applications with Nuxt 4, Nitro, Prisma, TypeScript, and Vue 3. It enforces a severity-tiered Analysis First workflow using NeuroForge memory files, schema-validated server contracts, cached data fetching with Pinia Colada, Laws of UX and accessibility standards, reusable Shadcn app wrappers, and senior SaaS engineering standards.
